about: A few words on rankings that surprise, shown by a mark on the item's row (see _build/notes.py). items: the item ids the note is for. specs: the specs it shows for, as CLASS N (left out: every spec). slot: the slot it shows in (left out: any). simulated: true when it speaks of the simulation, and shows only in a list ranked by it. en, fr: the text in each language. Of the notes of an item, the first that fits a row is shown. Effect values use the archived WoWSims Forever profile or the updated faction-specific controls documented in docs/audit-forever.

notes.en: Mortal Strike uses the weapon’s base damage roll. Arcanite Reaper hits for 153–256 and adds 62 attack power. Blade of Hanna hits for 96–145, has no permanent stats and requires 30 charges to trigger its bonus.
notes.fr: Frappe mortelle utilise les dégâts de base par coup. La Déchireuse en arcanite frappe à 153–256 et donne 62 PA. Blade of Hanna frappe à 96–145, sans stats permanentes, et demande 30 charges pour déclencher son bonus.

notes.en: With Stormshroud shoulders and pants, the gloves complete the energy bonus. Against Devilsaur Gauntlets they gain about 103 DPS in the archived simulator and 43 DPS with the November 21 update and its rotation.
notes.fr: Avec les épaules et le pantalon Stormshroud, les gants activent le bonus d’énergie. Face aux gants du diablosaure, leur avance passe de 103 DPS dans le moteur archivé à 43 DPS avec la mise à jour du 21 novembre et sa rotation.

notes.en: Its 68 spell power helps Holy Shock. At 3.70 seconds per swing, it triggers the spell-power part of Seal of Righteousness much less often than Blade of Hanna at 2.00.
notes.fr: Ses 68 de puissance des sorts profitent à Horion sacré. Un coup toutes les 3,70 s déclenche la part du Sceau de piété liée à la puissance des sorts bien moins souvent qu’avec Blade of Hanna, à 2,00 s.

notes.en: Its extra attack counts for this Holy Shock build. It adds about 6 DPS in the reference set, compared with 9.5 for Weakness Analyzer or Smolderweb’s Eye.
notes.fr: Son attaque supplémentaire compte pour ce profil Horion sacré. Le bijou ajoute environ 6 DPS sur la tenue de référence, contre 9,5 pour Weakness Analyzer ou Smolderweb’s Eye.

notes.en: Champion of the Light converts 60% of its 38 Intellect into spell damage. Its 21 Agility and 14 critical strike rating also benefit this melee caster.

notes.en: With Heartseeker or Dal’Rend’s Sacred Charge in the main hand, Shadowsong’s Sorrow beats Felstriker off hand by about 4 DPS. With Felstriker main hand, Distracting Dagger leads Shadowsong by about 3 DPS. Felstriker’s proc briefly guarantees hits and critical strikes.
notes.fr: Avec Heartseeker ou Dal’Rend’s Sacred Charge en main droite, Shadowsong’s Sorrow devance Felstriker d’environ 4 DPS en main gauche. Avec Felstriker en main droite, Distracting Dagger devance Shadowsong d’environ 3 DPS. Le proc de Felstriker garantit temporairement le toucher et le critique.

notes.en: Lefty’s 5 extra Agility narrowly outweigh Tunnelweb’s 6 crit rating with Shadowblade main hand. With Sageblade or Tooth of the Matriarch main hand, Tunnelweb wins by less than half a DPS.
